record.title: Omniscient Reader
record.description:
Dokja was an average office worker whose sole interest was reading his favorite web novel "Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse." But when the novel suddenly becomes reality, he is the only person who knows how the world will end. Armed with this realization, Dokja uses his understanding to change the course of the story, and the world, as he knows it.

record.title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint (Novel)
record.description:
**IF YOU ARE READING THIS, YOU WILL SURVIVE.**

Kill each other within the time limit or die. It’s just another evening commute on the train, until the passengers are given an order they can’t disobey. Utter chaos ensues, but ordinary office worker Dokja Kim only feels an unsettling calm. He knows exactly how this will play out! The subway car, the passengers’ reactions, even the bizarre creature that suddenly appears to oversee this sadistic scenario…everything is straight out of his favorite story, an online novel so obscure he is its sole reader. And as the only one who knows where the plot is headed, Dokja must use his knowledge to survive the oncoming apocalypse!

*Source: Yen Press, Vol. 1*

record.title: The Omniscient One
record.description:
Born labeled as mentally challenged, a rural boy named Huang Ji defies all expectations by mastering the power of omniscience. He senses the malice of the entire universe and the desperate plight of humankind: unknowingly kept in captivity by aliens, preyed upon by human traitors who traffic people in secret and worship the extraterrestrials, and facing an imminent apocalypse. As the true master of all knowledge, Huang Ji resolves to shoulder the burden of saving the world and vows to carve out a new home for humanity within the Galactic Alliance. (Source: [Webnovel](https://webnovel.com/comic/the-omniscient-one_33459534800866601))

Iruka visits a hospitalized Kakashi.  Their time together is short, and Kakashi is in a physically weakened condition, so Iruka has to be... creative.

record.title: The Genius Sales Person: Mind Reader
record.description:
Jihun Min is a diligent and honest medical sales representative who is trying to make a name for himself in a company that is rampant with nepotism. Hence, he is constantly being outshined by his general manager’s nephew, Junseong Choi, who monopolizes sales performance through lobbying and shady tactics. One day, Jihun is blessed with a special ability that could propel him forward in his career. Things are finally going his way and he’s feeling more optimistic than ever, but will Jihun be able to maintain his strong moral compass and not lose sight of what truly matters?

record.title: Crush of a Lifetime
record.description:
Hyeji is a famous SNS star with over 100,000 Instagram followers. Due to her popularity, Hyeji has received many confessions, but despite that, she does not really have much dating experience. One day, Hyeji received an invitation to go out on a date with another popular SNS star who she secretly followed. On the day of the long-awaited date, Hyeji couldn't stand the subtle light coming from the karaoke bar, so she decided to use her feet to take a selfie. But due to an accident, Kisung, who was a part-timer at that time, ended up seeing her in that embarrassing position.

After that Disastrous Date, Hyeji decides to end her first-ever relationship. However, on her first day at school, she meets Haeri. The person who gave her that embarrassing memory.
